text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear claim that driverless cars will \"speed up the death rate\"","quality":"explicit thesis","description":"The essay states a direct position early so the reader knows exactly what it is arguing."},{"evidence":"uses Google cars, BMW traffic jam assistant, and liability laws","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay brings in multiple details from the article to back up its position rather than relying on general statements."},{"evidence":"\"First, Second, Third\" structure","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly organized into a sequence of supporting points."},{"evidence":"\"if the technology fails and someone gets injured who is to blame\"","quality":"argumentative reasoning","description":"The essay explains why the evidence matters by connecting the technology to safety and responsibility concerns."},{"evidence":"conclusion restates that the cars are \"not really driverless\" and warns about danger","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends by revisiting the main claim and reinforcing the warning to the reader."}]}
